purpose: fixed bounded 60-scene backlog; no AI-authored story text and no unverified source anchors
sourcePolicy: Existing six original-text-anchored color briefs; later positions are deliberately NOT validated scenes until source text is audited

items.sourceExcerpt: Mr. Phileas Fogg lived, in 1872, at No. 7, Saville Row
items.description: Saville Row townhouse exterior, London 1872; do not claim an authenticated building facade.
items.altEn: Modern colored Victorian interpretation of a Saville Row street exterior in 1872.
items.altAr: رسم ملوّن حديث لشارع سافيل رو في لندن سنة 1872، دون توثيق الواجهة التاريخية للمنزل.

items.sourceExcerpt: A rap at this moment sounded on the door of the cosy apartment
items.description: New servant Passepartout bows before seated Fogg as James Forster introduces him.
items.altEn: Passepartout bows as he is introduced to the seated Phileas Fogg.
items.altAr: باسبارتو ينحني أمام فيلياس فوغ الجالس في لحظة تقديم الخادم الجديد.

items.sourceExcerpt: He suddenly observed, hung over the clock, a card
items.description: Passepartout alone examines the daily schedule card above the clock in Fogg's house.
items.altEn: Passepartout examines a household schedule card above the clock.
items.altAr: باسبارتو يتفحص بطاقة جدول المهام اليومية المعلّقة فوق الساعة.

items.sourceExcerpt: I will bet twenty thousand pounds against anyone who wishes
items.description: Reform Club gentlemen and Fogg discuss his wager; no railway travel in this scene.
items.altEn: Phileas Fogg calmly makes his wager before the gentlemen of the Reform Club.
items.altAr: فيلياس فوغ يعلن رهانه بهدوء أمام أعضاء نادي الإصلاح.

items.sourceExcerpt: He mechanically set about making the preparations for departure.
items.description: Passepartout packs for his sudden journey in his London quarters.
items.altEn: Passepartout prepares his belongings for an unexpected journey.
items.altAr: باسبارتو يجهز أمتعته استعدادًا لرحلة مفاجئة.

items.sourceExcerpt: Under his arm might have been observed a red-bound copy of Bradshaw’s
items.description: Fogg holds his red-bound Bradshaw railway guide and carries a carpetbag before setting off.
items.altEn: Phileas Fogg carries a red-bound railway timetable guide and a travel bag.
items.altAr: فيلياس فوغ يحمل دليل مواعيد القطارات ذا الغلاف الأحمر وحقيبة السفر.

items.sourceExcerpt: The commissioner of police was sitting in his office at nine o’clock one evening
items.description: At nine in the evening in a historically plausible 1872 London police commissioner's office, an anonymous commissioner seated at his desk receives an urgent telegraphic dispatch placed into his hands; focus on the physical telegram, the desk and the recipient, without invented readable contents.
items.altEn: A police commissioner receives a telegram at his London office in the evening, as the investigation into Phileas Fogg develops.
items.altAr: مفوض شرطة يتسلم برقية مساءً داخل مكتبه في لندن مع تطور التحقيق المتعلق بفيلياس فوغ.

items.sourceExcerpt: Little by little the scene on the quay became more animated; sailors of various nations, merchants, ship-brokers, porters, fellahs, bustled to and fro
items.description: An expansive single-scene view of the Suez quay in 1872 as it grows lively before the steamship's arrival: sailors, merchants, ship brokers, porters and fellahs move along the jetty; the clear chilly daylight reveals town minarets and traditional small boats on the Red Sea, without foregrounding any named protagonist or depicting the Mongolia already docked.
items.altEn: Busy Suez quayside with sailors, merchants and porters, minarets and small Red Sea boats before the Mongolia arrives.
items.altAr: رصيف السويس المزدحم بالبحارة والتجار والحمالين، مع المآذن والقوارب الصغيرة قبل وصول الباخرة منغوليا.

items.sourceExcerpt: The detective passed down the quay, and rapidly made his way to the consul’s office
items.description: In 1872 Suez, a distant rear-view of Detective Fix hurrying along the quay toward the British consul's office, immediately before his meeting with the consul; one authentic period harbor approach with no identifiable face, no other recurring characters, and no depiction of later passport events.
items.altEn: Detective Fix walks briskly along the Suez quay toward the consul's office, viewed from behind.
items.altAr: المحقق فيكس يسير مسرعًا على رصيف السويس باتجاه مكتب القنصل، ويظهر من الخلف دون ملامح وجه مفترضة.

items.sourceExcerpt: Passepartout pulled out his big watch.
items.description: On the Suez quay at noon in 1872, Passepartout pulls his large inherited pocket watch out while speaking with Detective Fix, who has just told him it is twelve o'clock; show their immediate interaction and the timepiece as the central object, no railway station, no train, no London setting, no invented dial numerals, no other recurring characters.
items.altEn: On the Suez quay, Passepartout draws out his large pocket watch in surprise while talking with Detective Fix about the local time.
items.altAr: على رصيف السويس يُخرج باسبارتو ساعته الكبيرة متعجبًا أثناء حديثه مع المحقق فيكس عن التوقيت المحلي.

items.sourceExcerpt: But the Red Sea is full of caprice, and often boisterous, like most long and narrow gulfs.
items.description: A single moment at sea aboard the steamship Mongolia in the Red Sea after leaving Suez in 1872: strong wind from one of the bordering coasts drives choppy waves against the long hull, visibly making the vessel roll. Exterior maritime view of the ship continuing towards the straits of Bab-el-Mandeb despite the wind and waves. No named passengers are depicted; avoid inventing a particular African or Asian coastline or a specific time of day.
items.altEn: The steamship Mongolia rolls through rough Red Sea waves while continuing toward Bab-el-Mandeb.
items.altAr: الباخرة منغوليا تتمايل وسط أمواج البحر الأحمر الهائجة وتواصل رحلتها نحو باب المندب.

items.sourceExcerpt: The passengers of the Mongolia went ashore at half-past four p.m.; at exactly eight the train would start for Calcutta.
items.description: A single historically grounded afternoon moment at the Bombay harbor in 1872: ordinary unnamed passengers from the steamship Mongolia disembark onto the shore at half-past four in the afternoon. Focus on the gangway, quayside and arriving passengers, not the later eight o'clock Calcutta train. No identifiable recurring protagonists and no speculative named port architecture.
items.altEn: Unnamed passengers from the Mongolia disembark at Bombay harbor at half-past four in the afternoon, before the evening train to Calcutta.
items.altAr: ينزل ركاب الباخرة منغوليا إلى رصيف ميناء بومباي عند الرابعة والنصف عصرًا، قبل موعد القطار المسائي إلى كلكتا.

items.sourceExcerpt: The train stopped, at eight o’clock, in the midst of a glade some fifteen miles beyond Rothal
items.description: A single morning moment in Chapter XI, 1872 India: the railway train has stopped at eight o'clock in a forest glade about fifteen miles beyond Rothal, near several bungalows and workmen's cabins. Show the stationary period train and an anonymous conductor moving alongside the carriages to call passengers out, with date palms and acacias around the clearing. Keep the track and train visible but do not depict the later elephant purchase, unfinished rail terminus explanation or the travelers' reaction.
items.altEn: A train stops at eight in a forest clearing beyond Rothal, while a conductor calls passengers to get out near bungalows and workmen's cabins.
items.altAr: يتوقف القطار عند الثامنة صباحًا في فسحة وسط الغابة بعد روثال، وينادي المحصّل الركاب للنزول قرب الأكواخ ومساكن العمال.

items.sourceExcerpt: The principal chain of the Vindhias was crossed by eight in the evening, and another halt was made on the northern slope, in a ruined bungalow.
items.description: A single twilight landscape in 1872 Bundelcund after the Vindhia mountain crossing at eight in the evening: the north-facing slope and a weathered, ruined bungalow where the party will stop for the night. Depict the isolated bungalow, rough mountainous forest terrain and fading evening light without inventing a named character's face, the elephant ride, or the later nighttime campfire.
items.altEn: A ruined bungalow on the northern slope of the Vindhia Mountains at eight in the evening, the next halt on the journey toward Allahabad.
items.altAr: كوخ متهدم على المنحدر الشمالي لجبال فينديا عند الثامنة مساءً، حيث تتوقف الرحلة في طريقها إلى الله آباد.

items.sourceExcerpt: In the background, among the trees, the pagoda of Pillaji loomed distinctly.
items.description: One scene at deepening night in the forest near the pagoda of Pillaji, 1872 Bundelcund: the pagoda visible among trees in the background, with the rajah's guards holding bare sabres and keeping watch at its doors by torchlight. The guards are the focus; anonymous distant figures only, without recognizable Fogg, Passepartout, Sir Francis, the guide or Aouda. Show the guarded entrance rather than the later rescue, pyre, dawn procession or an assault.
items.altEn: Torchlit guards with drawn sabres patrol the doors of the pagoda of Pillaji among the trees at night.
items.altAr: حراس يحملون سيوفًا مسلولة ويراقبون أبواب معبد بيلاجي على ضوء المشاعل بين الأشجار ليلًا.

items.sourceExcerpt: The station at Allahabad was reached about ten o’clock, and, the interrupted line of railway being resumed
items.description: A single scene in 1872 at Allahabad railway station around ten o'clock, showing the resumption of the interrupted railway line after the overland elephant detour. Focus on the historical station, railway tracks and stationary period rail carriages, with anonymous distant railway workers only. Do not depict the travelers' identifiable faces, the earlier elephant journey, or the future Calcutta steamer; this is the arrival and rail connection at Allahabad, not a departure from Bombay.
items.altEn: At about ten o'clock, the railway station at Allahabad marks the resumption of the train route toward Calcutta.
items.altAr: محطة الله آباد قرابة الساعة العاشرة، حيث يُستأنف خط السكك الحديدية المتوقف باتجاه كلكتا.

items.sourceExcerpt: They first passed through the “black town,” with its narrow streets
items.description: Single 1872 Calcutta street-view during the twenty-minute carriage journey to the court: a visual contrast between narrow streets with modest huts in the so-called black town and the adjoining European town with bright brick mansions shaded by coconut trees, masts in the distance and passing period horsemen. Depict the streets and architecture as the focus; no close-up of Fogg, Aouda, Passepartout or the arresting policeman, no courtroom, no harbour steamer, and no invented readable signs.
items.altEn: The carriage route crosses contrasting Calcutta neighborhoods, from narrow lanes to brick mansions shaded by coconut trees.
items.altAr: مشهد من طريق العربة في كلكتا بين الأزقة الضيقة والمنازل المبنية بالطوب والمظللة بأشجار جوز الهند.
